Watch the team investigate swamp beasts lurking across shadowy swamps, eerie bayous, stealthy everglades, and the legendary Boggy Creek. These wild creatures stalk and terrorize wherever they roam! Tune in to new episodes of Expedition X, Wednesdays at 9P on Discovery.

About Expedition X:
Explorer Josh Gates has put together a team to undertake investigations delving into realms beyond the "unknown." Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres join his quest to mount unprecedented expeditions into the unexplained and perhaps unexplainable.
